question.text:
According to the molecular orbital theory which of the following statement is incorrect?
[LUMO = lowest unoccupied molecular orbital]

options.text: LUMO level for  <math><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub></math>   molecule is  <math><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">σ</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn><mi mathvariant="normal">p</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">x</mi></mrow></msub></math>   orbital.
In  <math><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub></math>  molecules both the bonds  <math><mi mathvariant="normal">π</mi></math>   are bonds

In  <math><msubsup><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn><mo>-</mo></mrow></msubsup></math>  ion there is one  <math><mi mathvariant="normal">σ</mi></math>   and two  <math><mi mathvariant="normal">π</mi></math> bonds

solution.text: <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi><mn>2</mn></msub><mo>=</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">σ</mi><mn>1</mn><msup><mi mathvariant="normal">s</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo><</mo><mover><mi mathvariant="normal">σ</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">*</mi></mover><mn>1</mn><msup><mi mathvariant="normal">s</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo><</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">σ</mi><mn>2</mn><msup><mi mathvariant="normal">s</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo><</mo><mover><mi mathvariant="normal">σ</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">*</mi></mover><mn>2</mn><msup><mi mathvariant="normal">s</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo><</mo><mfrac><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">π</mi><mn>2</mn><msubsup><mi mathvariant="normal">p</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">y</mi><mn>2 </mn></msubsup><mo>= </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">π</mi><mn>2</mn><msubsup><mi mathvariant="normal">p</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">y</mi><mn>2</mn></msubsup></mrow><mtext>HOMO</mtext></mfrac><mo><</mo><mfrac><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">σ</mi><mn>2</mn><msub><mi mathvariant="normal">p</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">x</mi></msub><mi mathvariant="normal">o</mi></mrow><mtext>LUMO</mtext></mfrac></math> , all electrons are paired so diamagnetic.
